correctness.rationale: The natural right-translation equivalence is exactly equality of group labels by centerlessness of S_n. The induced quotient permutation preserves conjugation and is a group automorphism; its restriction to the identity fiber forces this automorphism to be inner, including n=6. After removing a diagonal automorphism, a fiberwise map preserves the operation iff g^(-1)h a_(h^(-1)gh)=a_g g^(-1)h, which is equivalent to class-equivariant choices in Z(C_G(g)). This proves necessity/sufficiency, direct-product commutation and uniqueness. Standard permutation centralizer wreath products yield each factor. The identity R_h=T_h F_delta^(-1) identifies exactly the known inner group, and the n>=4 class-twist construction proves a proper outer quotient. Explicit stdlib verification of all choices at n=3,4 returned VERIFY_OK; higher-rank conclusion rests on proof. No external certification claimed.

value.rationale: For Kai’s newly constructed universal embedding quandle the complete automorphism group is a natural missing invariant, not a chosen narrow slice. The theorem identifies all hidden conjugacy-class-local symmetries, gives exact orders for every n, explains why exceptional outer automorphisms of S_6 do not lift, and isolates the sharp n=3 versus n>=4 transition. This is a mathematically motivated all-rank structural classification and genuine extension of the known inner-group result.
